📰 U.S. Derivatives Market: How Can Crypto Custodians Challenge Banks?

U.S. crypto custodians are trying to take over a derivatives settlement business worth billions of dollars a day—a domain traditionally controlled by banks. But it remains to be seen whether the tailwinds from shifts in congressional power and regulatory easing will be enough to help them break through the banks’ barriers.

Why does this matter?
Crypto custodians’ desire to take over banks’ core business is, at its heart, a contest to control the gateway through which digital currencies penetrate the traditional financial system. Banks have the backing of a century of credibility and deep capital reserves, while crypto custodians rely on technological advantages and favorable policy winds. Regulatory easing may seem beneficial, but shifts in congressional power make the policy outlook more uncertain. If new lawmakers favor tighter regulation, the banks’ barriers will only become more formidable. This means crypto custodians’ expansion is not just a contest between competitors, but also a wager on the regulatory cycle facing the entire industry.

Market impact
This competition will directly affect the long-term investment cases for BTC and ETH. Banks’ exit from the settlement market could release substantial liquidity into crypto markets; at the same time, the risk of tighter regulation could make investors more cautious. For BTC and ETH, the near-term outlook may benefit from improved sentiment driven by favorable policy, but in the medium term, it will depend on whether custodians can establish a genuine cost advantage. Historically, disruptive technologies challenging traditional industries—such as ATMs replacing bank tellers—have often been accompanied by intense price battles lasting several years, or even a decade.

Trading strategy
If custodians can successfully lower settlement costs and build brand trust, that would be a long-term bullish signal. In the short term, however, regulatory uncertainty and a bank counterattack could keep markets volatile. This means that betting directly on crypto custodians to win is extremely difficult right now; it is more like watching the starting point of a long-term trend. If Congress suddenly introduces strict regulations, this thesis no longer holds.

📰 美国衍生品市场：加密托管商凭什么挑战银行？

美国加密货币托管商正试图接管每天数十亿美元的衍生品结算业务，这本来是银行的地盘。但国会权力变更和监管放松带来的利好，是否足够支撑他们打破银行壁垒，目前还悬而未决。

为什么这条新闻重要？
加密托管商觊觎银行的核心业务，本质是争夺传统金融体系被数字货币渗透的入口。银行有百年信誉背书和雄厚资本，而加密托管商靠的是技术优势+政策风口。监管松绑看似有利，但国会权力变更意味着政策走向会变数更大——如果新议员更倾向于严格监管，银行壁垒只会更牢固。这意味着，加密托管商的扩张不仅是对手竞技，更是对整个行业监管周期的赌注。

对市场的影响
这场竞争会直接影响BTC和ETH的长期价值逻辑。银行退出结算市场，会释放大量流动性到加密市场；但同时，监管收紧的风险会让资金流向更加谨慎。对BTC和ETH来说，短期内看是政策利好带来的情绪提振，但中期需要看托管商能否真正建立成本优势。历史上，类似颠覆性技术冲击传统行业的案例（如ATM对银行柜员），往往伴随着几年甚至十年的激烈价格拉锯。

操作思路
如果托管商能成功降低结算成本并建立品牌信任，这将是一个长期看多的信号。但短期内，监管不确定性和银行的反扑会让市场反复。这意味着现在直接押注加密托管商胜出的难度极大，更像是观察一个长期趋势的起点。如果国会突然出台严厉监管，这个判断作废。

Title: What exactly is Microsoft trying to do with this patent? AI training could rely on users’ idle computing power

Microsoft has filed a patent for training AI using users’ idle computing power. It could change the game, but it also raises concerns about privacy and hardware wear and tear.

Microsoft’s new patent proposes something different: paying users to contribute their computer’s idle processing power to train AI. Put simply, when you’re not using your computer, Microsoft could rent its computing power to help develop AI and pay you for it. If this becomes a reality, ordinary people could take part in AI training, but privacy, hardware wear and tear, and how much money users could earn are all concerns.

Impact on the market
- Short term: It could drive up demand for computing power, benefiting chipmakers like NVIDIA, though it depends on how difficult it is to implement. Sentiment-wise, it’s positive for the AI sector.
- Medium term: If users are receptive, AI training costs could fall, benefiting the industry as a whole. But if privacy and hardware wear and tear aren’t properly addressed, the industry could attract regulatory scrutiny again.

My take
I think this could benefit computing-power providers in the short term, but whether it takes off depends on whether users are willing to sell their computing power. Don’t be too harsh if I’m wrong—I’m only trying it with a small position myself.

The FSB is calling on Turkey to strengthen crypto regulation and establish rules for stablecoins—a move that could have a significant impact on the local crypto industry and investors.

The Financial Stability Board (FSB) is weighing in again, and this time it has singled out Turkey. The FSB recommends that Turkey go further in issuing crypto licenses, step up enforcement, and cooperate more with regulators in other countries. Put simply, the FSB thinks Turkey's crypto regulations are a bit lax and wants the country to keep pace with international standards. Although Turkey has recently made good progress in issuing crypto licenses, the FSB thinks it isn't enough: the rules also need to be enforced more strictly, rather than just paying lip service to them. This could put some pressure on Turkey's crypto industry in the short term. In the long run, though, it's hard to say whether clearer regulations will help or hurt the industry.

Impact on the market
- Short term: The FSB's comments could cause local crypto trading volumes in Turkey to dip, as investors wait to see how the policy will be implemented. Capital could initially flow out of Turkey as the market watches how other countries respond.
- Medium term: If Turkey fully implements the FSB's recommendations, it could set an example for crypto regulation across the Middle East and potentially reshape the industry. Regulatory trends are becoming increasingly clear, and crypto may have to meet compliance requirements to grow in the future.

My take
The FSB's demands are a double-edged sword for Turkey's crypto industry. In the short term, tighter regulations will surely drive some speculative capital away, and prices may come under some pressure. ETH is down 61% from its ATH, making it look deeply oversold. But the Fear and Greed Index is just 13, with a weekly average of 25. On-chain, you can't just look at price. You need to watch three things: whether whales are accumulating or distributing, whether net exchange inflows continue to rise, and whether active addresses are recovering. Rising net inflows with no increase in active addresses means coins are leaving holders' hands, while real-world usage isn't keeping pace. Conversely, outflows combined with a rebound in activity would provide a basis for a medium-term bottom.

BTCS holds 46676 ETH and has sold ETH at a loss to maintain its $64 million Aave loan. A drop below around $1,700 could trigger liquidation. In practical terms, this means that if leveraged whales are forced to close their positions, individual risk can translate into selling pressure across the market and also affect the risk controls of collateralized lending institutions. 【散户最容易犯的错：把跌得多当成便宜】

ETH较ATH跌了61%，看起来已经超跌，但恐惧贪婪指数只有13，周均25；24小时跌3.8%，7日跌13.8%，30日跌20.4%，成交量放大到超过市值5%。这说明卖压还没消化，1866.9是眼前支撑，2055.74是反弹阻力。

BTCS持有46676 ETH，为维持6400万美元Aave贷款，在亏损情况下卖出ETH，跌破约1700美元可能触发清算。落到实处，这意味着杠杆型大户一旦被动平仓，会把个体风险传导成市场卖压，也会影响抵押借贷机构的风控。SoFiUSD进入Polygon支付栈，说明应用生态还在推进，但应用落地不等于ETH马上受益。

title: 恐贪跌到13，ETF那批人平均已经亏了一成半
subTitle:
13。

这是今早恐惧贪婪指数的读数，前天还是 28，昨天 20，一天一个台阶往下走。我翻了下自己这几年的记录，能掉到这个位置的日子屈指可数。

先给结论：我觉得这一轮的问题不在恐慌本身，而在没人接。恐慌会过去，但接盘的钱回不来，价格就只能慢慢磨。

BTC 现在 6.8 万出头，24 小时跌了 3.7%，一周跌了一成，今早又刷出近 30 天新低。从 30 天内 8.4 万的高点算，已经回撤快两成。

真正让我在意的是一个数字。Decrypt 引用的分析师估算，美国现货 BTC ETF 的平均持仓成本在 8.1 万左右。也就是说，这批过去两年最稳的买家，平均已经浮亏一成半。CoinDesk 用 SoSoValue 数据算了一下，这些 ETF 今年已经转成净流出 15.6 亿美元，截至周四这一周又流出 6.4 亿，这是今年第 12 个单周流出超 5 亿的星期。

另一个数字是稳定币。Glassnode 口径，截至 11 月 9 日的 30 天里稳定币总量少了 142 亿美元，是 2022 年 6 月以来收缩最快的一次。场外的子弹在变少，不是在等着进场。

再叠加通胀数据偏热，市场已经把 12 月加息基本押满了。这几个放在一起，我不太相信几根大阳线就能把趋势扭过来。

位置上我自己是这么看的：昨天日内低点 67831 是第一道，跌破的话 6.7 万是不少人盯着的下一档；上面 7 万整数关和昨天高点 71137 都变成了压力，收不回 7 万之前，我不把反弹当反转。

ETH 更弱一些。1927，24 小时跌 3.8%，一周跌了近 14%，离 30 天高点 2473 已经回撤两成多，昨天最低摸到 1905。1900 这个整数位今天大概率会被反复试，2000 收不回来之前，ETH 对 BTC 也还在走弱。

山寨这边，市值前 250 里 24 小时收涨的只有七十来个，其中还掺着不少稳定币。

跌得最狠的几个也值得说两句：
- Bitway 一天跌两成，一周跌三成多。有链上监测提到币安上它的资金费率一度深度为负，空头拥挤，但持仓在降，说明不是在加空，是多头在离场。
- Celestia 跌近 14%，跌穿了 0.40 附近的支撑，那一带也是很多人看的 200 日均线。没有项目自身的利空，纯属大盘拖累加技术破位。
- Ether.fi 跌了一成多，它的质押 TVL 一周少了近一成，和 ETH 走弱是一回事。

相对抗跌的是 Bittensor 小涨 2% 左右，AVAX 一周只跌了 1.5%，TRX 也只跌 1% 上下。SOL 不太乐观，77.97，一周跌 13%，它的 ETF 从 10 月 21 日之后就没有过一个净流入日。

今天是周六，美股休市，ETF 没有新数据，周末订单簿本来就薄，一根针扫下来往往比平时深。下周有零售销售、英伟达财报和会议纪要，周一的 ETF 流向我会第一个看。

我的习惯是这种时候少动手：不加杠杆，不用"跌了很多"当买入理由，真想分批买的，也等 ETF 先连着出现两三天净流入再说。

最后问一个好回答的：恐贪 13 的时候，你是把交易软件关了，还是反而在挂单？

Europe’s data is a wake-up call. In the short term, the stablecoin rally may need to catch its breath. In the long run, the key factor is how regulation develops. I’m about 70% confident in this view; I’ll leave the remaining 30% up to the market. What do you think?

📰 U.S. lawmakers press for chip export data: AI competition suddenly changes the rules—should crypto markets panic?

Senators Warren and Coons are urging the Trump administration to preserve Nvidia’s export records, possibly to limit rivals such as China from obtaining advanced AI chips. If the U.S. government really tightens export controls on tech giants like Nvidia, it could affect not only the AI hardware supply chain but also demand for high-performance computing in crypto markets. That would be bad news for compute-intensive DeFi and AI gaming projects.

Why does this news matter?
The underlying reason is that the U.S. has elevated high-tech export controls to the level of a national security battle. Chip suppliers such as Nvidia are key players in the AI race. Rivals such as China are stockpiling computing power through acquisitions, mining, and other means, and the U.S. move to suddenly “retrieve” export data is tantamount to hitting pause on the global AI hardware market. This is another escalation in the technological decoupling between the U.S. and China, but crypto markets could get caught in the crossfire.

Market impact
In the short term, sentiment around the news is bearish, while tech stocks tied to AI hardware may benefit (although NVDA itself has made no move, its peers could be affected). For crypto markets, the main impact is that computing power rental costs could rise as high-performance GPUs become harder to obtain. DeFi projects rely on chips from manufacturers such as Nvidia for large-scale computing. If export restrictions are tightened, these projects may take longer to verify transactions or settle them, worsening the user experience.

A similar historical event was the U.S. chip ban on Huawei in 2018. At the time, demand for computing power in crypto markets was only beginning to grow, so the impact was relatively limited. But with AI gaming now on the rise and demand for high-performance computing surging, the impact of a policy shift will be greater.

How to approach it
The impact of this news on crypto markets is more about sentiment; the actual outcome will depend on the details of U.S. policy. If the government is only asking to collect data, the impact will be limited. If it really imposes strict export restrictions, computing power rental costs will rise, benefiting projects that can build their own computing capacity, while overall market sentiment will turn cautious. This means computing power projects need to pay closer attention to policy developments, while ordinary investors should watch whether this could trigger a price war over AI chips.

If the U.S. later escalates AI chip export controls to a comprehensive ban, this assessment will no longer apply.

参议员沃伦和库恩敦促特朗普政府保存英伟达出口记录，这可能是为了限制中国等对手获取先进AI芯片。如果美政府真的收紧对英伟达等科技巨头的出口管制，不仅AI硬件供应链会受影响，加密市场的高性能计算需求可能也会跟着受挫。这对依赖算力的DeFi和AI链游项目来说，不是什么好消息。

为什么这条新闻重要？
这件事的根本原因在于美国把高科技出口管制提升到国家安全战的高度。英伟达等芯片供应商是AI竞赛的关键棋子，中国等竞争对手通过收购、挖矿等方式囤积算力，美国突然要“回收”出口数据，相当于给全球AI硬件市场按下暂停键。这背后是中美科技脱钩的进一步升级，但加密市场可能被“躺枪”。

$ETH It’s now at 1,935, after hitting a low of 1,895.95 yesterday. Ten days ago (November 4), the daily candle still closed at 2,424. It’s fallen 20% in ten days, even worse than BTC’s 15% drop over the same period.

What concerns me most isn’t the size of the drop, but where the price is. On August 19, ETH surged from 1,906 to 2,333 in one big bullish candle—that was the starting point of this rally. Now the price is back in the low 1,900s, giving back all the gains from the past three months. Below that, from late July to mid-August, ETH traded sideways between 1,820 and 1,945 for nearly a month. That’s the next major support zone.

What worries me more is the derivatives data. On OKX, the latest long/short ratio for ETH perpetual futures accounts is 3.49, even higher than BTC’s 3.23. ETH futures open interest, measured on a daily basis, fell from $1.76 billion to $1.69 billion—not by much. After a 20% drop, leveraged longs haven’t really fled; they’re still holding on.

translatedData.content:
ETH Public Infrastructure Case | Bhutan Digital Identity Uses an On-Chain Registry | $1,934: Don’t Buy the Bounce

My view is that we should acknowledge real-world application progress, but not directly translate government adoption cases into buying pressure for ETH. On November 3, the Ethereum Foundation published an article on digital public infrastructure, describing how Bhutan’s National Digital Identity (NDI) uses Ethereum to help verify digital credentials. The Foundation’s case page further explains that a shared on-chain registry records information about recognized credential issuers and credential types, while individuals’ sensitive credentials remain in their own NDI wallets and are not made public on-chain. Not every issuance or verification requires an Ethereum transaction, either. A March announcement from Bhutan’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs confirmed that NDI wallets and electronic identity verification have been integrated into the passport system. The case page mentions that, by the end of 2025, about 449,500 users had completed NDI onboarding. That figure uses an older statistical measure and should not be presented as the number of new users today.

Why does this matter to the market? Public institutions need to recognize one another’s identities, but it is not appropriate to publish people’s raw personal data on-chain, and they do not want to depend entirely on a single operator. Ethereum, as a publicly accessible registry that can be independently verified, offers one way to coordinate; the actual authority to issue identities and set policies remains with Bhutanese institutions. Over the long term, if more public services use on-chain registration, settlement, and verification, network activity could increase. In the short term, however, these systems often keep large amounts of personal data and routine operations off-chain, and a single case does not imply significant growth in gas revenue or demand for ETH. Saying “the identity system uses Ethereum” means “the government bought large amounts of ETH” is unsupported by evidence.

The market’s reaction is also a reminder to distinguish application value from trade timing. ETH/USDT was around $1,934 on Binance, down about 4.1% over 24 hours, with a low of $1,895.95 and a high of $2,020.13, and was still below $2,000. Farside has fully reported net outflows of about $70.5 million from U.S. spot ETH funds for November 12; the uncompleted entry for November 13 cannot be treated as a confirmed zero inflow. ETH appeared among the top six-hour “Most Searched” assets on Binance Square, but search volume does not indicate net capital inflows. I’m watching support around $1,900, a short-term recovery to $1,950, and confirmation at $2,000. If the price stays below $1,895, my short-term stabilization thesis is invalidated.

If I were trading this myself, I wouldn’t enter now. I’d only consider a spot long, with a position size of 0. I would only test the waters with no more than 5% of my total trading capital if a four-hour candle closed above $2,000, the price held above $1,980 on a retest, and fund flows stopped deteriorating consistently. The first target is $2,020, where I’d sell half; I’d hold the rest for $2,060, but exit if price and volume diverge. I’d place the initial stop below $1,950. After entry, I’d exit the entire position if two consecutive four-hour candles closed below $1,980, or if a new project security risk emerged. If the price breaks below $1,895 first, I’d cancel the plan and wait for a new setup rather than using high leverage to bet on a long-term narrative.

#ETH

ETH公共基础设施案例｜不丹数字身份用链上登记簿｜1934美元不抢反弹

我的态度是承认真实应用进展，但不把政府采用案例直接折算成ETH买盘。以太坊基金会11月3日发布数字公共基础设施文章，介绍不丹国家数字身份NDI如何用以太坊协助验证数字凭证。基金会案例页进一步说明：链上共享登记簿记录受认可的凭证签发者及凭证类型信息，个人敏感凭证留在自己的NDI钱包中，不公开放到链上；每一次签发或验证也不一定需要发起以太坊交易。不丹外交部今年3月的公告证实，NDI钱包与电子身份核验已经接入护照系统。案例页提到截至2025年底累计约44.95万用户完成NDI入驻，这是旧统计口径，不能写成今天新增用户。

为什么这值得市场看？公共机构之间需要互认身份，却不适合把个人原始资料公开在链上，也不愿完全依赖单一运营商。以太坊作为可独立验证的公共登记层，提供了一种协调方法；实际身份签发权和政策仍由不丹机构管理。长期看，若更多公共服务使用链上登记、结算和验证，可能增加网络活动；短期看，这类系统往往把大量个人数据与日常操作放在链外，单个案例并不能推出Gas收入或ETH需求会显著增长。把“身份系统采用以太坊”说成“政府买入大量ETH”，没有证据。

市场的反应也提醒我们要分清应用价值和交易时点。查看Binance ETH/USDT时约1934美元，24小时跌约4.1%，区间低点1895.95、高点2020.13，仍在2000下方。Farside已完整披露的11月12日美国现货ETH基金净流出约7050万美元；11月13日尚未填完的栏位不能当作确定的零流入。币安广场6小时Most Searched有ETH，但搜索量不代表资金净流入。我观察1900附近的支撑、1950的短线回收和2000的确认；若持续跌破1895，短线企稳判断就失效。

如果是我自己交易，现在不参与，方向只考虑现货多单，仓位为0。只有4小时收盘站上2000美元、回踩1980不破，并看到基金流向不再持续恶化，我才以总交易资金最多5%试仓。目标先看2020，触及减掉一半；余仓看2060，出现量价背离就平仓。初始止损放在1950下方；入场后两根4小时K线重新收于1980以下，或有新的项目安全风险，也全部退出。若先跌破1895则取消计划，等待新结构，不用高杠杆押长期叙事。

title: ETH和Gas费：一条链的油钱是怎么回事
subTitle:
转账要交Gas费、mint个NFT要Gas费，这钱付给谁了？

【本质】以太坊是一台全球共享的计算机，每笔操作（转账、交易、跑
合约）都要消耗计算资源。Gas就是你付给帮你执行计算的验证者的
「油钱」。网络越堵，大家抢着执行，油价（Gas单价）越高。

【为什么和币价有关】行情火爆→链上交易暴增→Gas费飙升。所以老玩家
有个习惯：链上操作挑深夜或行情冷清的时候，同样的操作能省一半钱。

【和投资的关联】Gas费水平是链上活跃度的实时温度计。持续高Gas=
链上需求旺盛；长期冷清=应用使用减少。把它当链上情绪的辅助观察，
挺有意思。

你怎么看？评论区聊聊你的经历。
#ETH #Gas #BTC

translatedData.title: ETH and Gas Fees: What Are a Blockchain’s Fuel Costs?
translatedData.subTitle:
You pay Gas fees to transfer funds or mint an NFT—but who gets that money?

【The essence】Ethereum is a globally shared computer. Every operation (transfers, trades, running
contracts) consumes computing resources. Gas is what you pay the validators who help carry out the computations.
“Fuel costs.” The more congested the network, the more people compete to have their transactions processed, and the higher the gas price (the unit price of Gas).

【Why they’re related to coin prices】A booming market → a surge in on-chain transactions → skyrocketing Gas fees. That’s why experienced users
have a habit: they do on-chain operations late at night or when the market is quiet. The same operation can cost half as much.

BloombergNEF的最新报告显示，美国数据中心日益增长的能源需求正推动燃气电厂装机量飙升，可能导致全国电力碳排放增加10%。这背后是云服务需求激增和可再生能源转型受阻的双重压力，直接影响美国气候目标的实现，并可能引发更严格的能源监管政策。

title: USDT为什么能锚定1美元？稳定币的运转原理
subTitle:
玩合约离不开USDT，但很多朋友没想过它凭什么值1美元。

【原理】稳定币由发行方运营：你给它1美元，它发给你1个USDT，并把
美元（及等值资产）存进储备。市场上谁想把USDT换回美元，就向发行
方赎回。这套「申购-赎回」机制像锚一样，把价格钉在1美元附近。
价格偶尔偏离一点点（比如0.999），套利者马上搬砖抹平。

【要关心的风险】储备透明度。USDT定期公布储备报告（含美债等资产），
但历史上稳定币圈出过事——储备不够的稳定币脱锚崩掉，持有人血本
无归。所以：大额资金别长期躺在单一稳定币里，分散是免费的保险。

【How it works】A stablecoin is operated by an issuer: you give it $1, and it gives you 1 USDT, while placing
dollars (and equivalent assets) in its reserves. Anyone in the market who wants to exchange USDT back for dollars can redeem it from the issuer
redeem from the issuer. This “minting-redemption” mechanism acts like an anchor, keeping the price close to $1.
The price sometimes deviates slightly (for example, to 0.999), and arbitrageurs quickly step in to bring it back in line.

Ethereum Market Depth Analysis: Weakness Amid Institutional Selling and a Technical Breakdown

I. Price Trend Analysis

As of November 13, 2026, Ethereum’s spot price stood at $1,928, down approximately 4.2% over the past 24 hours, after touching an intraday low of $1,915. Like Bitcoin, Ethereum is under pressure from multiple bearish factors, but it is showing relatively weaker performance in some respects.

On the hourly chart, Ethereum fell steadily from $1,953 to around $1,922 over the past five trading hours. Trading volume expanded significantly during the decline. Volume during the third hour reached 14.68 million USDT, more than twice the normal level, indicating concentrated selling. Volume subsequently eased, but the price failed to stage a meaningful rebound, suggesting weak buying pressure.

In terms of moving averages, Ethereum’s current price has fallen below all short- and medium-term moving averages. The 7-day moving average is at $1,937, the 25-day moving average is at $1,950, and the 99-day moving average is as high as $2,035. The price is more than 5% below the 99-day moving average, indicating that the medium-term trend has clearly turned bearish. As for the Bollinger Bands, the lower band is at $1,911 and the middle band at $1,939. The price is trading below the middle band and close to the lower band. A short-term oversold rebound is possible, but the overall picture remains bearish.

II. Technical Indicator Analysis

Ethereum’s overall technical indicators are also giving a clear sell signal. Of the 15 technical factors, nine point to selling, five to buying, and one is neutral, putting the proportion of sell signals at 60%. The composite indicator value is -1, with a historical win rate of 80.65%, suggesting that the bearish signal is relatively reliable.

As for the RSI, the 6-period RSI is 31.56 and the 12-period RSI is 35.08. While neither has entered deeply oversold territory, both are nearing the oversold threshold of 30. Compared with Bitcoin, Ethereum’s RSI readings are slightly higher, indicating that it is relatively less oversold, but also that a rebound is less urgent than Bitcoin’s.

The MACD shows the DIFF line at -17.03 and the signal line at -18.01. Although the histogram is positive at 0.98, its value continues to shrink. The MACD is below the zero line, and the histogram has not expanded meaningfully, indicating that the bearish trend is continuing and a trend reversal is unlikely in the short term. On the KDJ indicator, the K line is at 29.17, the D line at 35.62, and the J line at 16.27. All three are at low levels, and the K line is below the D line, forming a typical bearish alignment.

The Williams %R indicator has fallen to -85.76, in oversold territory. The Stochastic RSI plunged from 92.59 to 34.20, a sharp decline. The simultaneous weakening of these oscillators further confirms Ethereum’s short-term weakness. Notably, the ATR remains around 20.11. Volatility has risen somewhat but is not yet extreme, suggesting that although the market is falling, panic selling has not yet emerged.

III. Market Sentiment Analysis

Ethereum faces pressures similar to Bitcoin’s, along with some of its own distinct bearish factors. First, spot ETH ETFs continue to see redemptions, with recent net outflows exceeding $330 million, severely weighing on spot liquidity. Second, the Ethereum Foundation and early holders have engaged in concentrated selling through DEXs, with on-chain outflows exceeding $35 million in a single hour, adding to selling pressure.

On the news front, expectations of macroeconomic interest rate hikes, falling technology stocks, and rising Treasury yields are also weighing on Ethereum. In addition, Ethereum’s weaker performance relative to Bitcoin reflects a market preference for Bitcoin—an asset with a larger market capitalization and greater liquidity—when risk appetite declines. As a high-beta asset, Ethereum has come under greater selling pressure.

On-chain data shows that the OBV indicator has continued to decline, reaching -654,592, indicating persistent outflows. The price is trading below the middle Bollinger Band and close to the lower band. Although a technical rebound is possible in the short term, its strength and duration may be limited without a clear positive catalyst. $1,900 is an important psychological level; if it breaks, $1,850 will be the next key support zone.

For investors, Ethereum’s current risk-reward profile is not attractive. Until the trend clearly turns bearish, it may be prudent to stay on the sidelines or maintain a small position, waiting for a technical rebound after the RSI enters deeply oversold territory, or for the price to regain the 25-day moving average before considering adding to positions. During periods of high market uncertainty, risk control and position management are more important than pursuing returns.

以太坊市场深度分析：机构抛售与技术破位下的弱势格局

一、价格走势分析

截至二零二六年十一月十三日，以太坊现货价格报一千九百二十八美元，过去二十四小时内下跌约百分之四点二，盘中最低触及一千九百一十五美元。与比特币类似，以太坊同样面临着多重利空因素的压制，但其在某些方面表现出更弱的相对强度。

从小时K线来看，以太坊在过去五个交易小时内从一千九百五十三美元持续下跌至一千九百二十二美元附近。下跌过程中的成交量明显放大，第三个小时的报价成交量达到一千四百六十八万USDT，是正常水平的两倍以上，说明市场出现了集中性的抛售行为。随后虽然成交量有所回落，但价格并未出现有效反弹，显示买盘力量薄弱。

从均线系统来看，以太坊当前价格已经跌破了所有短中期均线。七日均线位于一千九百三十七美元，二十五日均线位于一千九百五十美元，九十九日均线更是高达两千零三十五美元。价格与九十九日均线之间的差距超过百分之五，表明中期趋势已经明确转空。布林带方面，下轨位于一千九百一十一美元，中轨位于一千九百三十九美元，价格在中轨下方运行，且接近下轨，短期存在超卖反弹的可能，但整体格局偏空。

二、技术指标解读

以太坊的综合技术指标同样发出明确的做空信号。十五个技术因子中，九个为做空方向，五个为做多方向，一个中性，做空比例同样为百分之六十。复合指标值为负一，历史胜率为百分之八十点六五，空头信号具有较高的可靠性。

RSI指标方面，六周期RSI为三十一点五六，十二周期RSI为三十五点零八，虽然尚未进入极端超卖区域，但已经接近三十的超卖线。与比特币相比，以太坊的RSI读数略高，说明超卖程度相对较轻，但也意味着反弹的紧迫性不如比特币那么强烈。

MACD指标显示，DIFF线位于负十七点零三，信号线位于负十八点零一，柱状图虽然为正值零点九八，但数值持续缩小。MACD在零轴下方运行，且柱状图未能有效放大，说明空头趋势仍在延续，短期内难以出现趋势性反转。KDJ指标中，K线为二十九点一七，D线为三十五点六二，J线为十六点二七，三线均处于低位且K线低于D线，形成典型的空头排列。

威廉指标降至负八十五点七六，处于超卖区域。随机RSI从九十二点五九快速下滑至三十四点二零，跌速明显。这些震荡指标的同时走弱，进一步确认了以太坊的短期弱势格局。值得注意的是，ATR指标维持在二十点一一左右，波动率虽然有所上升但尚未达到极端水平，说明市场虽然下跌但尚未出现恐慌性抛售。

三、市场情绪分析

以太坊面临的市场压力与比特币有相似之处，但也有其独特的利空因素。首先，现货ETH ETF持续遭遇赎回，近期净流出超过三亿三千万美元，对现货流动性造成严重拖累。其次，以太坊基金会和早期持有者通过DEX集中抛售，单小时链上流出超过三千五百万美元，加剧了市场的抛售压力。

从消息面来看，宏观层面的加息预期、科技股下跌以及国债收益率上升同样对以太坊构成压力。此外，以太坊相对比特币的弱势表现，反映出市场在风险偏好下降时，资金更倾向于持有市值更大、流动性更好的比特币，而以太坊作为高贝塔资产，承受了更大的抛压。

从链上数据来看，OBV指标持续走低至负六十五万四千五百九十二，说明资金持续流出。价格运行在布林带中轨下方，且接近下轨，短期内虽然存在技术性反弹的可能，但在缺乏明确利好催化剂的情况下，反弹的力度和持续性可能有限。一千九百美元是重要的心理关口，如果跌破，下方一千八百五十美元将是下一个关键支撑区域。

对于投资者而言，当前以太坊的风险收益比并不理想。在趋势明确转空之前，建议保持观望或轻仓操作，等待RSI进入极端超卖区域后的技术性反弹机会，或者等待价格重新站上二十五日均线后再考虑加仓。在市场不确定性较高的时期，控制风险和仓位管理比追求收益更为重要。

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | Staying Out Is a Position Too—and It’s the One Pros Use Most
translatedData.subTitle:
The biggest misconception beginners have: if you’re not holding a position, you’re not trading. So they stay fully invested, constantly buying and selling,
until fees and market swings wear away their capital.

In reality, staying out of the market is the only position with zero losses. Stay out when you don’t understand the market,
Staying out when bulls and bears are battling it out, and staying out after a string of losing trades—the money you save at these three moments
is more than most traders make from their trades.

You may be tired of the hunting analogy, but the principle holds true: hunters spend most of their time waiting. Pulling the trigger
takes only a second. When you have capital, you’ll have ammunition when an opportunity comes along. Hold on to your ammunition.

ETH falls to around 1,930 | ETHA quarterly report reflects past buying | I’ll wait for confirmation from new inflows

My stance is to first check the time frame of the fund flows, rather than use quarterly holdings to validate today’s rebound. BlackRock’s iShares Ethereum Trust ETF (ETHA) quarterly report filed with the U.S. SEC, covering the period through September 30, shows that ETHA shares increased from 119.04 million at the end of June to 162.426667 million at the end of September. During the quarter, 52.64 million shares were created and approximately 9.2533 million were redeemed. The fund’s net asset value rose from approximately $4.293 billion to $9.900 billion over the same period. At first glance, this looks like strong growth, but the report also explicitly states that a large part of it came from the rise in ETH’s price during the quarter. The increase in net assets cannot all be counted as new inflows.

This distinction is especially important today. The report covers July through September, and its November 6 filing does not turn the end-of-September data into real-time holdings for November. The quarter-end increase in ETHA shares indicates prior demand for institutional products, but it does not prove that the fund was still making net purchases on November 13. Farside’s complete figures for November 12 show combined net outflows of approximately $70.5 million from U.S. spot ETH funds, including net outflows of approximately $62 million from ETHA. The November 13 table has not yet been populated with figures for individual funds, so an automatically calculated total of zero cannot be interpreted as funds having flowed back in that day. Past quarterly growth and recent daily redemptions need to be considered together.

The price action is equally cautious. At the time of writing, ETH/USDT on Binance was around $1,930.63, with a 24-hour high of $2,021.11 and a low of $1,895.95, down approximately 4.15% from 24 hours earlier and back below $2,000. Compared with the end-of-September ETH reference price of $2,693.88 cited in the report, the market price has changed significantly. But this cannot be used to infer how much ETH the fund sold that day, because share creations and redemptions, asset prices, and market-maker inventory are not the same thing. U.S. October PPI was still up 6.5% year over year, and macro rate expectations also affect the risk budgets investors are willing to allocate to assets with no cash flow.

Looking at the mechanics, spot funds such as ETHA provide a way for investors to gain exposure to ETH through traditional accounts. Changes in creations and redemptions may affect authorized participants’ spot hedging and inventory arrangements, but the impact on the immediate spot price is not one-to-one. The report also notes that the fund’s management fee is charged at an annualized rate of 0.25% of net assets, so long-term holders need to account for fees as well as price risk. Traders who see “fund assets doubled” without separating price appreciation from new shares may misjudge the strength of institutional buying.

The key levels I’m watching are 1,895–1,900 as the recent low zone, 1,930 as the current reference, 2,000 as the level to reclaim, and 2,021 as the 24-hour high. If ETH can regain and hold above 2,000, pull back without breaking below it, and subsequent complete fund-flow data improve, a short-term recovery would be more credible. If it breaks below 1,895 and cannot quickly recover, my recovery scenario is invalidated. If new SEC filings show that the quarter-end data have been revised, the figures will need to be recalculated rather than relying on the old table.

If I were trading this myself, I would not chase the price right now. I would only consider a small, unleveraged spot long. I would enter with 2% of total capital only if two consecutive one-hour candles close above 2,000, price pulls back to 1,990–2,000 without breaking below that range, and the latest complete ETF data have not deteriorated further. The first target would be 2,021; I would take half off there and move the stop on the remainder to around the entry price. The second target would be 2,070, where I would close the position. I would place the initial stop below 1,960 and exit entirely early if 1,895 is lost or fund outflows expand significantly. If all conditions are not met, I would stay out of the market. I would keep the account risk per trade to approximately 0.3%.

ETH跌至1930附近｜ETHA季报显示旧买盘｜我先等新资金确认

我的态度是先核对资金的时间维度，不用季度持仓给今天的反弹背书。贝莱德iShares Ethereum Trust ETF向美国SEC提交的截至9月30日季报显示，ETHA份额从6月末的1.1904亿份增至9月末的1.62426667亿份；季度内新创设5264万份、赎回约925.33万份。基金净资产价值同期由约42.93亿美元增至99.00亿美元。表面看是强劲增长，但季报也明确说，其中很大部分来自当季ETH价格上涨，不能把净资产增量全部算成新资金流入。

这个区分对今天格外重要。季报覆盖的是7至9月，11月6日提交也不会把9月末数据变成11月实时持仓。ETHA份额的季末增加说明此前有机构产品需求，却不能证明11月13日的基金仍在持续净买入。Farside已完整列示的11月12日美国现货ETH基金合计净流出约7050万美元，其中ETHA约净流出6200万美元；11月13日表格尚未填入各基金数字，自动合计0不能解读成当日资金已回流。旧季度增长与新日度赎回要一起看。

价格给出的反馈同样谨慎。撰稿时币安ETH/USDT约1930.63，24小时高点2021.11、低点1895.95，较24小时前下跌约4.15%，重新跌在2000美元下方。相较季报所述9月末ETH参考价2693.88美元，当前市场定价已明显变化；但这不能用来倒推基金当天卖出了多少ETH，因为份额申赎、资产价格和做市库存不是一回事。美国10月PPI同比仍为6.5%，宏观利率预期也会影响愿意持有无现金流资产的风险预算。

再看制度机制，ETHA等现货基金提供传统账户持有ETH风险敞口的渠道，申赎变化可能影响授权参与者的现货对冲与库存安排；其对即时现货价格的传导并非一比一。季报还提到基金管理费按净资产年化0.25%计提，长期持有人需要把费用和价格风险一起算。交易者看到“基金资产翻倍”若不拆分价格上涨与新份额，容易误判机构买盘强度。

关键位我看1895至1900为本轮低点区、1930为当前参考、2000为重夺关口、2021为24小时上沿。若能重新站稳2000并回踩不破，且后续完整基金流向改善，短线修复才更可信；若跌破1895并不能迅速收回，我的修复预案作废。若新的SEC文件显示季末数据被修订，也要重新计算，不能依赖旧表格。

如果是我自己交易，目前不参与追价，方向仅考虑无杠杆现货小仓位做多。只有两根一小时K线收于2000上方、回踩1990至2000不破，并且最新完整ETF数据没有进一步恶化，才以总资金2%试仓；第一目标2021，到位减半并把余仓止损抬至入场附近，第二目标2070，到位平仓。初始止损放在1960下方，若失守1895或基金流出明显扩大，提前全部退出。条件不齐就空仓，单次账户风险控制在约0.3%。

【Title: Why Is Bitcoin’s Security Upgrade Facing New Challenges?】  

Blockstream’s new custody system is now live, but Adam Back is also calling for a simpler cold-storage solution, suggesting that existing approaches still need improvement.  

Blockstream and Thales have teamed up to launch a new Bitcoin custody system that uses dedicated hardware to handle transaction signing in an effort to improve security. But Blockstream co-founder Adam Back spoke out around the same time, advocating a return to simpler offline storage (cold wallets), which he believes is the ultimate way to reduce network risk. He seems to have reservations about the new system, believing that overly complex hardware solutions could introduce hidden vulnerabilities. BTC is currently facing resistance around $68.2K, and this debate over security approaches could affect institutions’ willingness to adopt custody services.  

Market impact  
- Short term: Institutions may become more cautious about custody services, prioritizing security testing over piling on features.  
- Medium term: If cold storage gains market acceptance, existing custody businesses will need to accelerate upgrades that combine hardware and software safeguards, potentially passing on the costs.  

My take  
The debate between current custody solutions and cold storage is unlikely to produce a clear winner in the short term; it’s more likely that the two approaches will coexist. If BTC is to break above $70K, institutions’ confidence in security must be restored. No single solution can meet every need. Don’t be too hard on me if I’m wrong—I’m only trying this with a small position myself. I’m about 70% confident in this view; I’ll leave the other 30% to the market.

Most people spend 90% of their time predicting the market and 0% reviewing their own performance. They’ve got it backwards.

Write down three things for every trade: why you entered (your rationale), what went right or wrong (in terms of execution),
and what you’ll change next time (a specific action). Stick with it for a month, and you’ll be shocked to discover that your losses…
There are lots of the same mistakes repeating in your trade log—for example, always reversing your position right after a stop-loss,
or never holding on to winning trades.

The market changes, but your behavior patterns won’t change on their own unless you keep an eye on them and work to change them. The market is the most
honest teacher, and your trade records are your report card. Don’t just look at your account balance—go through your trading history.

【Down 14% in a week, 20% in a month: Who’s taking the hit from ETH’s plunge?】

ETH is around $1,922 today, down 4.6% in 24 hours. Over the past week, it’s down 14.1%; over the past month, 20.5%. This isn’t an ordinary pullback—it’s leveraged accounts being forced to reckon with the consequences.

Here’s a real-world example: publicly listed company BTCS used 46,676 ETH as collateral for a $64 million Aave loan. To protect the loan, the company has already sold ETH at a loss. If the price falls into the liquidation zone, the loan could be liquidated.

ETH here isn’t a matter of faith; it’s collateral. When the price rises, the collateral grows in value. When it falls, the collateral shrinks, interest keeps accruing, and the pressure line creeps closer. When institutions sell, the price weakens further; as the price weakens, they’re forced to sell more. That’s leveraged reflexivity: a position doesn’t just absorb market moves—it can create them.

In practice, the first to be affected are those borrowing against ETH, followed by those who think holding long term will shield them from liquidation, and then the market’s overall liquidity. Does the business logic hold up? Yes—but only if the collateral can withstand volatility. If it can’t, leverage becomes a chain reaction.

content:
【一周跌14%，一个月跌两成：ETH这刀砍在谁身上？】

今天ETH约1922美元，24小时跌4.6%；对比一周，7日跌14.1%；对比一个月，30日跌20.5%。不是普通回调，是杠杆账户被按着头算账。

有个现成案例：上市公司BTCS用46676枚ETH抵押6400万美元Aave贷款。为保贷款，公司已在亏损时卖ETH；若币价跌入清算区，贷款可能面临清算。

ETH在这里不是信仰，是抵押品。币涨，抵押品变厚；币跌，抵押品缩水，利息不减，压力线却压过来。机构一卖，价格更弱；价格更弱，又逼它继续卖。这叫杠杆反身性：仓位不只承受行情，还会制造行情。

落到实处，先受影响的是拿ETH抵押融资的人，其次是以为长期持有就能躲开清算的人，再往后就是整个市场的流动性。商业逻辑通不通？通，但前提是抵押品扛得住波动；扛不住，所谓杠杆就是连环套。

恐惧贪婪指数只有20。手是真痒，但这次真没上。2017年这套路我见过，当年包装的是ICO，今天包装成了财库故事。

记住：看ETH，先看谁拿它当抵押品。

这波你们手痒不痒？#ETH #加密市场 #MIHAO #盘感

translatedData.title: Trading Discipline | The five rules I keep posted beside my screen—sharing them exactly as written today
translatedData.subTitle:
On emotional days, people forget every principle. So I wrote these down and stuck them up where I can see them:

1. Write down your stop-loss level before entering a trade. If you can't, don't enter.
2. Never risk more than 2% of your capital on a single trade. No exceptions.
3. Never add to a losing position. Never average down.
4. After three consecutive losing trades, stop for the day. Watch, but don't trade.
5. Withdraw some of your profits. The money leaves; your peace of mind stays.

That's all five. Not one is about how to read the market. Because the reason people lose big money is never
that they misread the market—it's that their execution falls apart. Let's keep each other accountable.

The resignation of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has triggered wide-reaching investigations involving the U.S. Department of Justice (DOJ), the Department of Commerce, and U.S. Congressional committees. The inquiries focus on whether advanced AI hardware was illegally diverted to China and whether a targeted foreign intelligence operation compromised U.S. national security.
Key Entities Under Scrutiny
Megaspeed International: A Singapore-based cloud services provider—originally spun out from a Chinese company—that purchased over $4.8 billion in advanced Nvidia AI chips after major export restrictions took effect.Alice Huang (Huang Le): An executive at Megaspeed who was involved in an undisclosed extramarital relationship with Jensen Huang. U.S. intelligence agencies identified her as a suspected intelligence asset operating on behalf of Beijing.
Core National Security Concerns
AI Chip Diversion & Smuggling Loops: Regulators are investigating whether Megaspeed acted as a front company to route high-performance Nvidia GPUs (designed to power advanced AI infrastructure) around U.S. export controls directly to Chinese end-users.Human Espionage & Counterintelligence: Intelligence officials are evaluating potential vulnerabilities resulting from Alice Huang’s close proximity to Nvidia’s executive leadership, including potential leaks of confidential technology roadmaps, supply chain data, or strategic trade positions.Private Sector Due Diligence: The case has exposed enforcement gaps in third-party reseller oversight, raising questions about whether Nvidia properly vetted high-volume foreign cloud buyers operating near high-risk diversion corridors in Southeast Asia.
Federal Investigations & Congressional Inquiries

Corporate & Diplomatic Responses
Nvidia Board Statement: Nvidia’s Board of Directors stated that an internal review found "no reason to believe" that national security or proprietary technological secrets were compromised, though an independent law firm (Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz) continues to investigate internal governance failures.Megaspeed Statement: Megaspeed denied wrongdoing, maintaining that it takes compliance with American export laws "extremely seriously" and is working transparently with federal authorities.Chinese Foreign Ministry: Beijing dismissed the spy allegations as "unsubstantiated groundless speculation" and claimed the reports were politically motivated.

以太坊ETH市场深度分析：ETF赎回与巨鲸抛售双重夹击，关键支撑位面临考验

一、价格走势分析

截至二零二六年十一月十三日，以太坊报价一千九百四十七美元，过去二十四小时下跌约百分之三点四。从小时K线来看，ETH在触及一千九百五十六美元的日内高点后逐步回落，最近一根小时K线大幅下跌，最低触及一千九百二十四美元，最终收于一千九百二十六美元附近，成交量明显放大至五千三百九十一枚ETH，显示抛压显著增强。

以太坊本轮下跌的主要驱动力同样来自现货ETF的持续赎回。过去七天，现货以太坊ETF累计净流出超过四点三亿美元，ETF资产管理规模从二百四十亿美元缩减至二百一十七亿美元，机构投资者的持续撤离严重削弱了价格支撑。与此同时，链上出现了大规模的大户抛售行为。早期ICO参与者抛售了一万六千七百枚ETH，价值超过三千万美元，以太坊基金会也出售了两千枚ETH。这些大额卖单直接冲击了现货市场的流动性，导致价格快速跌破多个关键支撑位。

宏观环境方面，美联储加息预期的升温对以太坊构成了额外压力。美国银行预测美联储将连续三次加息，十年期美债收益率突破百分之五点一，强势美元环境不利于以太坊等风险资产的估值。此外，英伟达CEO辞职引发的科技股恐慌情绪也传导至加密市场，进一步放大了以太坊的跌幅。

二、技术指标解读

从均线系统来看，以太坊目前运行在所有主要均线下方。七小时均线为一千九百三十九美元，二十五小时均线为一千九百五十八美元，九十九小时均线高达二千零三十九美元。价格与长期均线之间存在约一百美元的差距，空头排列格局十分明显。EMA七为一千九百四十一美元，EMA二十五为一千九百六十美元，EMA九十九为二千零三十六美元，同样呈现典型的空头排列。

布林带方面，上轨已收窄至一千九百七十七美元，中轨约为一千九百四十三美元，下轨约为一千九百零九美元。价格在中轨附近波动，但最新一根K线的下跌使价格逼近下轨，暗示短期可能进入超卖区域。RSI指标显示，六周期RSI降至三十三点九四，十二周期RSI为三十六点三零，虽然尚未进入极端超卖区域，但已接近临界水平。

MACD方面，柱状图从三点五四下降至二点三六，多头动能持续衰减。MACD线为负十六点三一，信号线为负十八点六七，虽然柱状图仍为正值，但收窄趋势表明反弹动力不足。KDJ指标中，K值降至三十六点八五，D值为四十二点二七，J值降至二十六点零二，三线向下运行，短期空头趋势明确。威廉指标WR降至负八十点九一，进入超卖区域。综合因子统计显示，十五个因子中有九个发出做多信号，五个发出做空信号，综合指标发出做多信号，历史胜率为百分之七十四点四七。这表明尽管短期价格承压，但量化模型对中期走势仍持谨慎乐观态度。

三、市场情绪分析

当前以太坊市场情绪偏谨慎。币安广场的热门讨论集中在BTC暴跌对ETH的拖累效应、ETF资金外流以及大户抛售等话题。从资金流向来看，小时级别最大净流出达到负三千五百七十万美元，显示短期内卖盘力量十分集中。不过，以太坊生态层面仍有一些积极信号，例如DTCC宣布将在二零二七年将代币化服务整合至Solana，虽然这一消息直接利好Solana，但也反映了传统金融机构对区块链代币化的长期信心。

从链上活跃度来看，尽管价格下跌，以太坊网络上的DeFi协议总锁仓量仍保持相对稳定，表明长期持有者和DeFi用户并未大规模撤离。然而，短期内ETF赎回和大户抛售的双重压力仍将持续影响价格。投资者需要关注一千九百一十美元附近的支撑位，如果该位置失守，可能引发进一步的恐慌性抛售。

热门代币方面，SHELL当前报价零点零四零七四美元，二十四小时涨幅百分之一点一零；SOPH报价零点零零一七四美元，涨幅百分之零点三六；SOXSB报价五十二点八八美元，涨幅百分之零点一七。

Let’s do the math: earning just 1% a day over 250 trading days a year adds up to 12 times your money; earning a steady 10% a month
adds up to 30 times your money over three years. It doesn’t sound thrilling, but it has one remarkable quality—it doesn’t rely on luck.

Doubling your money depends on market conditions; compounding depends on discipline. Market opportunities have to be waited for, but discipline is yours. Don’t set your goal
as “doubling your money this week.” Set it as “making no major mistakes this week.” The money from the former is given by the market;
the ability behind the latter is yours. The market is open every day, but only those who preserve their capital are entitled to keep playing.

ETH falls below 2,000 | Glamsterdam audit still pending final conclusions | I’m watching security before any rebound

My stance is to wait and watch cautiously. The Ethereum Foundation’s statement, published on November 6 and updated on November 9, is clear: the next Glamsterdam upgrade is still at the testnet stage. EIP-8037 and EIP-8038 propose changes to Gas fees for state creation and access; the audit found that some deployed contracts rely on old invariants and could behave unexpectedly after the changes. Core developers have decided to delay the related hard-fork process and not upgrade Hoodi as originally planned until the issue is resolved. This is an officially confirmed engineering decision. It should not be described as a mainnet failure or as a canceled upgrade.

I see this as a risk-management event, not an immediate bearish trading signal. Changes to Gas rules can affect what contracts are able to do after failed calls, and some checks in older contracts may no longer work as developers originally expected. ChainSecurity’s technical write-up explains how these failure paths work, providing an independent cross-check of the Foundation’s announcement. For traders, security audits of this kind often affect the upgrade schedule and expectations for the ecosystem first, and may only later feed through to ETH’s valuation. There is clearly not enough evidence to infer from the headline alone that large amounts of on-chain assets have been compromised.

The official timeline lists the November 16 developer discussion and the November 19 follow-up technical meeting as upcoming milestones, and explicitly makes no advance commitment about the outcome. Delivery and publication of the audit report on November 13 are listed as plans in the announcement. Until I have reviewed the complete reports individually, I won’t claim that the scope of the vulnerability has been definitively established, let alone say that any protocol has suffered losses. Even if the specifications need to be adjusted, we should look to the developer meetings and updated official documents.

How has the market reacted so far? At the time of writing, ETH/USDT on Binance was around 1,940.65, with a 24-hour high of 2,022.56 and a low of 1,895.95—down about 3.84% from 24 hours earlier and below the 2,000-dollar mark. This decline also reflects macroeconomic and capital-flow factors, so it cannot be attributed to a single technical announcement. US October PPI was up 6.5% year over year, and the market still needs to digest interest-rate expectations. Farside’s complete data for November 12 shows net outflows from spot ETH funds; its November 13 table is not yet complete, so blank fields should not be treated as evidence that flows have reversed to either inflows or outflows.

For trading, I see 1,895–1,900 as the low-end zone to watch in this move, around 1,940 as the current trading reference, 2,000 as the first key level to reclaim, and around 2,023 as the 24-hour ceiling. A recovery above 2,000 followed by a successful retest would suggest buyers are beginning to absorb the news. If the rebound fails and price drops below 1,895 again, the short-term recovery thesis is invalidated. I would set the initial stop below 1,960, and exit the entire position immediately if officials disclose that the issue is more extensive or if price falls below 1,895 again. ETH跌破2000｜Glamsterdam审计仍待定案｜我先看安全再看反弹

我的态度是谨慎观望。以太坊基金会11月6日发布、11月9日更新的说明写得很清楚：下一次Glamsterdam升级仍在测试网阶段，EIP-8037和EIP-8038拟调整状态创建与访问的Gas计费；审计发现一些已部署合约依赖旧有的不变量，改动后可能出现异常。核心开发者决定延后相关硬分叉流程，并在问题解决前不让Hoodi按原计划升级。这是官方确认的工程决策，不能写成主网已经故障，也不能写成升级已取消。

我把它当作风险管理事件，而不是立刻的利空交易信号。Gas规则改变会影响合约在失败调用后还能执行什么，有些旧合约的检查路径可能不再按开发者原先预期工作。ChainSecurity的技术说明给出了这类失败路径的机制，算是对基金会公告的独立交叉核查。对交易者而言，这类安全审计往往先影响升级日程和生态预期，之后才可能传导至ETH估值；如果只看标题就推演成链上资产大规模受损，证据明显不够。

官方时间表把11月16日开发者讨论、11月19日下一步技术会议列为后续节点，并明确没有预先承诺结论。11月13日审计报告交付与公开属于公告中列出的安排；在逐份核对完整报告前，我不会断言漏洞范围已经最终确定，更不会声称某个协议已发生损失。即便规格需要调整，也应以开发者会议和更新后的正式文件为准。

市场已经怎样反应？撰稿时币安ETH/USDT约1940.65，24小时高点2022.56、低点1895.95，较24小时前下跌约3.84%，并处在2000美元整数位下方。这个下跌同时叠加宏观和资金因素，不能归因于一篇技术公告。美国10月PPI同比6.5%，市场仍需消化利率预期；Farside已完整列示的11月12日现货ETH基金是净流出，11月13日表格尚未补齐，不能把空栏当作流入或流出已反转。

交易上我将1895至1900看作这一轮低位观察区，1940附近是当前成交参考，2000是第一道重夺关口，2023附近是24小时上沿。若能收复2000并回踩站稳，才说明买盘开始消化消息；若反抽失败又失守1895，短线修复判断作废。协议安全问题是否可控，要看审计范围、规格调整和开发者会议，不靠K线本身判断。

如果是我自己交易，目前不参与，方向仅考虑现货轻仓做多。只有两根一小时K线收于2000之上、回踩1990至2000守住，且11月16日会议没有新增重大安全风险时，才以总资金2%试仓；第一目标2023，触及减半并把余仓止损移至入场附近，第二目标2070，到位清仓。初始止损设在1960下方，若官方披露问题扩大或价格重新跌破1895，立即全部退出。若条件一直不齐就保持空仓，单次账户风险不超过约0.3%，不使用杠杆追消息。

#ETH
以上仅为个人市场观察，不构成投资建议。

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | Your Brain Is Lying to You When You Hold on to a Losing Trade
translatedData.subTitle:
What does someone down 50% on a position focus on? The “all-time high,” thinking, “If it gets back to my entry price,
I’ll get out.” Be careful: this idea is driven entirely by attachment, not logic. The market doesn’t know your entry price;
it only responds to supply and demand right now.

Once you’re stuck holding a position, you’ll automatically seek out good news and block out bad news. This is called confirmation bias. You’ll think,
“This time is different.” Those five words have burned more money throughout history than any hacker ever has.

The antidote is actually simple, but hard to put into practice: before you open a position, write down “under what circumstances the logic behind this trade
no longer holds,” then act when that point is reached, regardless of how you feel. Separate your decisions from your position, and you’ll be able to see clearly.

ETH falls nearly 4% | BitMine posts approximately $6.3 billion fiscal-year loss | Distinguish paper losses from selling pressure

My stance is cautious and watchful. I’m not directly interpreting a company’s massive reported loss as “institutions are dumping.” BitMine’s fiscal 2026 net loss is being widely discussed on Binance Square. First, look at the timing of the filing: These figures are for the fiscal year ended August 31, 2026. In its 10-K filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission in November, the company reported a net loss of approximately $6.313 billion, including approximately $6.229 billion in unrealized losses on digital assets. The latter reflects paper fluctuations resulting from measuring held assets at fair value. It does not mean that an equivalent amount of ETH was sold, nor does it represent a cash outflow that occurred on November 13. Treating figures from a past fiscal year as today’s sell orders would lead to a misreading of market supply.

Cross-checking the company’s investor relations page, BitMine said on November 9 that it held approximately 6.07 million ETH. This is the company’s figure as of a specific date; it cannot be extrapolated to its current position, nor does it prove that the company has made no subsequent reductions. What really needs monitoring is future disclosures on holdings, staking or financing arrangements, liquidity on the balance sheet, and net flows into spot ETFs. A company’s paper losses do not mechanically trigger on-chain selling. But if financing constraints force the company to sell assets, the impact would shift from accounting fluctuations to actual supply. Evidence is needed to establish that this condition is present; headlines and speculation are not enough.

The market is already showing signs of strain: At the time of this observation, Binance ETHUSDT was around $1,939, down approximately 3.93% over the past 24 hours, with a high of $2,027.16 and a low of $1,895.95. The decline is a market fact, but the simultaneous buzz around the earnings report alone is not enough to establish causation. ETH跌近4%｜BitMine财年亏损约63亿美元｜先分清账面损失与抛售

我的态度是谨慎观望，暂不把企业财报里的巨额亏损直接翻译成“机构正在砸盘”。币安广场热议BitMine的2026财年净亏损。先看文件的时间：这是截至2026年8月31日的财年数据，公司11月向美国证监会提交的10-K披露净亏损约63.13亿美元，其中数字资产未实现损失约62.29亿美元。后者是持有资产按公允价值计量形成的账面波动，不等于同额ETH被卖出，更不是11月13日新发生的现金流出。把旧财年数字当成今日卖单，会误判市场供给。

交叉看公司投资者关系页面，BitMine于11月9日称ETH持有量达到约607万枚；这是一份有明确日期的公司口径，不能外推为此刻仓位，也不能据此断言之后绝无减持。真正需要盯的是后续持仓披露、质押或融资安排、资产负债表流动性，以及现货ETF的净流向。企业账面亏损本身不会机械触发链上卖盘，但如果融资约束迫使公司出售资产，传导路径就会从会计波动变成实际供给。这个条件目前需要证据，而非标题猜测。

市场已经显出压力：截至本次观察，币安ETHUSDT约1939美元，近24小时跌约3.93%，区间高点2027.16、低点1895.95。跌幅是行情事实，无法仅凭同时出现的财报热搜认定因果。我的观察位是1900和1896附近的低点带，以及上方1960、2027。若失守1896后反抽无力，说明买盘承接不足；若重新站稳1960并逐步收复2027，短线恐慌叙事才有被修正的价格证据。若公司后续正式披露主动卖出ETH或出现明确融资压力，我的观望偏稳判断也要重估。

如果是我自己交易，现在不追空、不抄底，方向为条件式小仓现货做多，等待一小时收盘重新站上1960且回踩不破，再用总资产的2%试仓；目标先看2000，后看2027。到2000减半，到2027再减剩余一半；一小时收盘跌回1930下方止损，或价格触及1896直接全部平仓。若先跌破1896，原计划作废，保持空仓等新的结构。仓位上限2%，不用杠杆；没有触发就没有成交，更谈不上收益。

In the 2018 downturn, the hardest part wasn’t how far prices fell, but how every rebound seemed to give investors another reason to exit. ETH’s price structure has a similar feel now: down 2.6% in 24 hours and 12.4% over 7 days, at $1,949.93, still below resistance at $2,063.89. My signal is clear: bearish; stay on the sidelines with a bearish bias. This is not a buy-the-dip signal.

$1,866.9 is the first support level. If it breaks, a test of around $1,700 cannot be ruled out. Sentiment has turned extremely cold, with the Fear and Greed Index at 20, below the weekly average of 27. This suggests selling pressure is nearing panic territory, but panic does not mean a bottom is in. More importantly, trading volume has surged abnormally to more than 5% of market cap. A major move may be brewing, but there has not yet been a convincing breakout to the upside.

On the ground, an ETH treasury firm has already sold ETH at a loss to keep its $64 million Aave loan healthy, with 46,676 ETH behind it. If ETH falls to around $1,700, the loan may become eligible for liquidation. This structure directly affects borrowing institutions, lenders, and market-making liquidity. Once leverage is forced to contract, on-chain selling pressure will intensify. The business logic is simple: as collateral loses value, institutions are forced to protect themselves first.

I’m not chasing shorts, but I won’t mistake a surge in volume for a reversal either. Only a recovery above $2,063.89 and a sustained hold there would mean the bulls have regained the initiative. What’s your signal?

【ETH像2018年暴跌后的弱势反抽】

2018年那轮下跌，最难受的不是跌得多，而是每次反弹都像在给资金撤退找理由。现在ETH的价格结构，也有这个味道：24小时跌2.6%，7日跌12.4%，报1949.93美元，仍压在2063.89美元阻力下方。我的信号很明确：空头，观望偏空，不是抄底多信号。

1866.9美元是第一道支撑，跌破后，不能排除市场去测试1700美元附近。情绪已经冷到极端，恐惧贪婪指数20，低于周均27；这说明卖压接近恐慌区，但恐慌不等于见底。更关键的是成交量异常放大，超过市值的5%，大波动正在附近酝酿，却还没给出有效向上突破。

落到实处看，ETH treasury firm为维持6400万美元Aave贷款健康，已经亏损卖出ETH，背后有46676枚ETH；若ETH跌到约1700美元，贷款可能进入清算资格。这个结构会直接影响借款机构、贷款方和做市流动性，杠杆一旦被动收缩，链上卖压会被放大，商业逻辑并不复杂：抵押品贬值，逼着机构先保命。

我不追空，但也不会把放量误判成反转。收复2063.89美元并持续站稳，才算多头重新拿回主动权。你的信号方向是？
